summary: K-Tech Solutions Co. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, announcing a strategic pivot into hunting and outdoor sporting equipment via a press release. The company projects a 200% revenue surge to $60 million by 2027 from sales of trail cameras and hearing protection earmuffs. No specific deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are disclosed. This is a forward-looking business strategy announcement without a concrete transaction. Watch for execution updates and actual acquisition details to assess the pivot’s viability.
